workarounds.symptom: Serialization: numpy float32/16 and pandas Series values leak NaN/Infinity past the JSON-compliance guard
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(serialization): sanitize nonfinite NumPy and pandas floats. Target files: src/backend/base/langflow/serialization/serialization.py, src/lfx/src/lfx/serialization/serialization.py, src/backend/tests/unit/serialization/test_serialization.py. NumPy scalars, arrays, and pandas Series now replace NaN and infinity with None in both serializers. Finite NumPy floats become native Python floats. Existing container shapes and truncation behavior stay the same. (Ref: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16297)
